_source: Vision and Core Values document from the school, supplied by the owner on 18 Oct 2026.

values.name: Tolerance
values.text: We live in a diverse country and for that we need to be tolerant individuals, who understand that some people will differ from you in opinions, gender, income and religion. We emphasise the ability to listen to differing opinions and keep an open mind.

values.name: Discipline
values.text: We will use positive and negative reinforcement to reward good behaviour and punish bad behaviour. At Al-Bayan, our focus is not only to educate the children but also to create good citizens of the country.

values.name: Equality
values.text: All decisions will be free of any discrimination based on gender, income, religion, or social status. We believe all people are created equal and everyone deserves an equal opportunity. This is one of the values we will be instilling in the students as well for a more inclusive future.

values.name: Merit
values.text: Merit is the sole criterion in our decision making. This applies to all aspects of our operations, from selection of faculty and staff, to admission and evaluation of students.

values.name: Character Building
values.text: We consider character building to be an integral part of our project because we are grooming the next generation of this country. They will be individuals who always put humanity first and respect others.
